name: Tryout
why: Uses any color's shop member as a one-off; real choice of which, plays off the shop.

name: Gather
why: Two scaling clauses for a plain income; the follower rider is the same text as Stash and Allowance.

name: Walk-In
why: Free blind recruit, with a small gift to everyone; quick and readable.

name: Promote
why: Trade up with a rival or the shop; a big swing the rival can see coming, though 'theirs' needs a second read.

name: Demote
why: Mirror of Promote that trades down; mostly a setup for Foster Parents and Martyrs, weaker alone.

name: Initiation
why: A free member up to 8 is a real round III burst any seat can grab.

name: Body Snatchers
why: Equal-cost swap each round; a fair sting Loyalists answers.

name: Volunteer
why: Blank cheap body for the red count; nothing happens when you play it.

name: Mentor & Protégés
why: Two members for one buy, counts 3; simple and strong for red's contest.

name: Proselytizers
why: Generic +1 per recruit; works the same in any cult.

name: Mob
why: Pays the leader of red's contest again each round; rich-get-richer.

name: Clerk
why: +1 red a round; forgettable and never the right buy.

name: Recruiter
why: Small income on every recruit, fits red's turnover but quiet.

name: Patriarch
why: Late scorer for wide cults; pays the player already ahead on members.

name: Foster Parents
why: Turns Promote, Demote, Body Snatchers and Poach into followers; a clear connector.

name: Deprogrammers
why: Worth 4 and counts 4 for 3 resources is a must-buy for the red contest; the ability is a small add-on.

name: Panel
why: A free Promote or Demote on recruit; does red's thing in its own words.

name: Loyalists
why: Clean answer to swaps; the table sees the wall and plans around it.

name: Sleep In
why: Big purple now for placing last; the token rules take a read.

name: Hold Up
why: Skip the next turn, even your own; a visible block with a timing call.

name: Right Away
why: Go again now; little gain but timing matters for spaces.

name: Last Call
why: Pays for holding minions back; strong but the token interaction is fiddly.

name: Crunch Time
why: Two turns in a row in few words; grab two spaces before anyone answers.

name: Overtime
why: An extra minion in round III is an obvious burst.

name: Courier
why: Rewards purple's in-a-row turns with every other color; builds toward full sets.

name: Night Watch
why: Pays off a rival's Goes Last token; narrow and needs the token rules.

name: Night Owls
why: An extra minion every round from II; strong, wording about timing is heavy.

name: Early Birds
why: Pure counter to skips; useful only if a purple rival is skipping.

name: Bouncers
why: Skip two rivals on recruit; a visible jolt that costs nobody a minion.

name: Bell Ringer
hardFail: unclear and needs tracking: 'unless it was placed before the skip' asks the table to remember placement history
why: Can't be read cold; nobody can say when it fires.

name: Gossip
why: Pays on every skip, so Hold Up and Bouncers feed it.

name: Timekeeper
why: +1 per purple member at the end; a flat scorer nobody notices.

name: Closer
why: Rewards going last, which purple's contest and token already chase.

name: Hot Streak
why: Big payoff for a chain of turns, but counting the turns just taken is memory work.

name: Picket Line
why: Passive drip when rivals take purple spaces; same shape as High Society.

name: Toast
why: Big silver with a gift that feeds rivals' contest; easy and generous.

name: Polish
why: Converting silver into colors; works but overlaps Sweet Talk and Yellow.

name: Party Gifts
why: Followers for gifts that build rivals' silver contest; the gift is the tension.

name: Potluck
hardFail: turn flow: each rival chooses a resource to give during your turn
why: A trade every rival has to decide on mid-turn.

name: Sweet Talk
why: Silver plus conversion; repeats Polish one ring later.

name: Largesse
why: Up to 10 followers for handing rivals the silver contest; a real round III call.

name: Godparent
why: Give a member away for its cost; links to Foster Parents and Old Maid.

name: Hostesses
why: Steady small gifts and followers; wordy for a drip.

name: Caterer
why: +1 silver whenever anyone gifts silver; small and 'gifted' is vague.

name: Guest of Honor
why: +4 followers each round for giving a cheap member away; plays off cheap filler.

name: Toastmaster
why: +1 follower per silver space; forgettable.

name: Envy
hardFail: relies on a rival holding more silver than you
why: Pays only when a rival has more; a catch-up shape Cory's rule excludes.

name: Debutantes
why: Double your silver once with a small gift; timing for the contest is the decision.

name: Smooth Talkers
why: Silver pays for any color; useful but expensive and generic.

name: Charity Ball
why: Gift and follower whenever a rival recruits; fires often, never a decision.

name: Creditor
why: Take 2 followers for 3 silver from a chosen rival; a forced trade, fair but mild.

name: Debt Collectors
why: Taking silver once runs against the color's giving.

name: High Society
why: Passive follower when rivals take silver spaces; quiet.

name: Harvest
why: The plain anchor: resources in your colors for sets.

name: Leaders' Tax
why: Reads where rivals are; the count is easy but the choice takes a look.

name: New Blood
why: Rewards a new color recruit; clear but the bonus is modest.

name: Housewarming
why: A free new-color member; widening in one move.

name: Melting Pot
why: Pays for a wide cult; the wide player is usually ahead.

name: Makeover
why: Rearrange everything for full sets right before round III scoring.

name: Gardeners
why: Fills color gaps each round; 'have none of' could mean members or resources.

name: Duty Collector
why: Taxes rivals' recruits in your colors; passive, no choices.

name: Tourist
why: Followers per color held, twice; clear and it grows with variety.

name: Seamstress
why: 'Double your full sets' doesn't say what you gain.

name: Dyer
why: Same per-color pattern as Tourist and Caravan, paying yellow.

name: Meddler
why: Breaks rivals' full sets; a mild sting with fiddly choices.

name: Drifters
why: Cheap wild member for any color count; a choice that links many cards.

name: Big Tent
why: Rewards exactly one member per color; shapes every later buy.

name: Caravan
why: Third copy of the per-color drip; bigger, rewards the wide leader.

name: Jack-of-All-Trades
why: Yellow as a wild in sets; a quiet helper for the contest.

name: Savings
why: Income plus a shop dig before buying; two clauses.

name: Out of Style
why: Clears a color from the shop; a block rivals feel and a refill gamble on choice.

name: Peek
why: Plan the pile and buy from it; good scaling blue.

name: Recruit Twice
why: Two buys in one turn; simple and strong.

name: Bury
why: Deny a rival's target and get paid for it.

name: Spree
why: Three buys in round III; a burst a trailing player can grab.

name: Hawker
hardFail: turn flow: rivals choose whether to recruit during your turn
why: An auction around the table; long and breaks the turn rule.

name: Patroness
why: Pays on every bury; ties the blue spaces together.

name: Snobs
why: Per-blue-member scorer; plain.

name: Window Shopper
why: Bury two and take their colors; who picks and what refills is a lot.

name: Shopaholics
why: Every turn is two buys; bends the core rule hard.

name: Scavenger
hardFail: turn flow: owner chooses to recruit during a rival's turn
why: Buys out of a rival's turn.

name: Window Dressers
why: Cheap 3-count body that churns the shop; filler with Patroness link.

name: Doormen
why: Swap a rival's member for a shop one; strong, wording is dense.

name: Regular
why: +1 blue on follower buys; dull.

name: Trendsetters
why: Bury on every recruit; overlaps Window Dressers.

name: Critic
why: +1 when rivals buy blue; rarely matters.

name: Help Yourself
why: Scaling split steal; the color's core in one line.

name: Stash
why: Same text as Gather and Allowance; nothing magenta about it.

name: Lie Low
why: Small steal and a shield; 'this round' needs a reminder token.

name: Heist
why: Take 3 followers from the leader; clear and aimed.

name: Shake Down
hardFail: turn flow: the rival chooses during your turn, and chooses their own punishment
why: Victim picks their own loss; feels bad.

name: Poach
why: Take the best member on the table in round III; the burst.

name: Cutpurse
why: Small steal from the richest each round; checks hoards.

name: Accomplice
why: Cheap one-shot steal of 3; simple way in.

name: Grifter
why: Steal scales with members; pays the wide leader.

name: Second-Story Man
why: Steal right before contests; a swing rivals can plan around.

name: Desperado
why: Bigger steals while behind; real catch-up.

name: Extortionist
why: Cutpurse doubled; repeats a sibling.

name: Bodyguards
why: Shield against steals; a counter, not an engine.

name: Double Agent
why: Trade itself for a rival's member; more Red's job.

name: Kidnapper
why: Takes the widest rival's member every round; losing members before round III feels bad.

name: Shoplifter
why: Steal on every recruit; grows with recruiting.

name: Fence
why: Paid when robbed; softens magenta for the victim.

name: Allowance
why: Same text as Gather and Stash; not white's idea.

name: Splurge
why: Followers for an expensive recruit; round III rate unstated.

name: Exchange
why: Resources to followers at double rate; clear white.

name: Farewell
why: Cash a member out for its cost; links to Martyrs.

name: Estate Sale
why: Farewell for white instead; a sibling.

name: Cash In
why: All white to followers; the payoff the color builds to.

name: Recluse
why: Pays for staying small against wide rivals; sharpens white's idea.

name: Barker
why: An extra follower buy with each recruit; bends the one-buy rule.

name: Heiresses
why: Once-a-game white per member; pays the wide player.

name: Brokers
why: +1 on White follower actions; small but stacks.

name: Misers
why: Rewards holding white against Cash In; a hold-or-spend call.

name: Raiders
why: A follower steal is Magenta's job.

name: Cashier
why: Cash In on a member; repeats the space.

name: Money Changers
why: White from everyone's follower buys; passive.

name: Martyrs
why: Losing it pays; turns Poach and swaps into gifts and links to Farewell.

name: Old Money
why: Flat white-member scorer; dull.

name: Magpie
why: All resources to white once, then Cash In or Misers; a setup payoff.

name: Build Up
why: The plain green anchor.

name: Echo
why: Copy the previous action; scales with what the table takes.

name: Reprise
why: Copy one of your own spaces; rewards a good first pick.

name: Sample
why: Borrow a rival's On Recruit; reads the table.

name: Cover
why: Copy an empty space; flexible.

name: Greatest Hits
why: Replays your whole On Recruit set; the round III payoff.

name: Song Request
why: Copy a rival's space once a round; Echo on a card.

name: Impersonator
why: Borrows a rival's ability; you must mark which one.

name: Impressionist
why: +1 when anyone copies; forgettable.

name: Wallflower
why: Doubles every copy; a big engine for the green leader.

name: Fan Club
why: Copy the leader's space; catch-up in green's words.

name: Roadie
why: Copy bonus per green member; small stacking.

name: Stunt Double
why: Take your space twice when you recruit; clear timing.

name: Tribute Band
why: Do all of a rival's spaces once; huge but costly and slow to resolve.

name: Doppelganger
why: Becomes your best member; a copy engine.

name: Agents
why: Shield against copying; a counter.

name: Encore
why: Doubles your next On Recruit; timing decision.

name: Party Crasher
why: Take a space a rival already holds; breaks the blocking rule once.

name: Alchemists
why: Wild payment and 3 followers for 5 any; must-buy.

name: Extra Hand
why: One extra minion once; pricey for one placement.

name: Line Cutters
why: Worth 3 for 2 and cancels catch-up turn order; must-buy for the leader.

name: Old Maid
why: A curse to hand rivals via Red, Silver or Magenta; purpose not obvious alone.

name: Dabblers
why: Wild 2-count member for every count contest; cheap filler.

name: Cheerleaders
why: Extra followers for contest winners; win-more.

name: Victors
hardFail: single-member card with a plural name
why: Extra resources for contest winners; win-more.

name: Anarchist
why: Swap any two members anywhere; strong table control, many targets to weigh.

name: Spoilsport
why: Cancel a contest you can't win; a block the leader sees coming.

name: Con Men
why: Big one-shot steal; flat.

name: Sore Loser
why: Steals 5 from the top winner when you win nothing; catch-up with a bite.
